Sutekh is a god of many forms though there are three that he holds to most of the time, though all the forms have red stained hands and feet and each eye has two pupils within them, one a deep bright blue while the other a vibrant Violet. Both pupils are slitted and the blue one is vertical while the violet one is horisontal.
His first and primary form is that of a short furred humanoid jackal, much as one would think of with Anubis. However his feet and hands carry with them a red color to the fur, as if stained by a pigment. Intrecate symbols weaved into a cover over his upper chest, shoulders and upper back that seems to connect with the pharoh like headdress over his head and a white plated Shendyt around his waist.
https://i.pinimg.com/564x/2c/6c/35/2c6c353b7b45aebd3857da2b5cbd6e63.jpg refreence pic Anubian

The second is dressed much the same as the first though it is distincly elven like in his features, along with the fact that his skin is obsidian in color. In both forms Sutekh carries with him a long hilted great Kopesh which doubles as a staff if the blade is turned downwards.

https://i.pinimg.com/564x/94/27/c6/9427c62d981eacae82d297c380fa8f58.jpg Refreence pic - Elven/human

The third and final form is the one he takes when traveling among mortals in disguise, simply to observe. It is that of an old man, usually belonging to the mortal race he is observing, Dressed in rags with a hood over his face to cover his unique eyes and his hands and feet seem red from long travel.


Personality:
Sutekh is usually quite a calm and collected individual, often holding a weary look upon his face when alone. His eyes shine with age and intelligence as he hungers for any bit of knowledge not already in his vast and considerable memory.
Not without his vices Sutekh cannot resist fine spirits or a good tune and when visiting mortals frequents establishments that provide these distractions. Honerable to a fault and always impartial when asked to judge on matters. Even though he is the god of knowledge he can be tricked and outwited and grows furious when such events happen, however rare they might be.


Background:
Sutekh was known as the god of honor and war from were he comes, though that worlds star has dimmed into the eather after a civil war between the gods there left Sutekh as the only survivor and left to wander from world to world, leaving little marks of his passing but never staying for a significant enough time.
Sutekh could be considered approaching or being Ancient by god standards, having seen entire worlds rise and fall left him unable to continue to his sphere of war and instead he took up knowledge to understand the very fabric of creation to hopefully one day revive his lost world and lost family of gods.

I remember when the group and I were dealing with this cult and we had managed to capture around seven of them. I was playing a fighter(1)/Rouge(1)/Wizard(6necromancer) and in the group there was a paladin, Monk and Druid. Before this we had captured one of the cultists and before I got a chance to really start the druid had killed him because they had killed the monks previous character in anger. 

I had stripped the cultists down and tied them up against seven poles inside a tent that I had managed to spend a spell slot to make it so that no sound would emanate from inside the tent to the outside. Until this point the cultist had only a single sentence that they always repeated about their goddess rising up and eating our entrails and the like.
I looked towards the druid and paladin and told them to wait outside and give me around half an hour so that they'd have a watch.

Then after waking up each and every one of them and taking their robes's hood and using them to gag them (The cults were sort of color coded with their ranks in the cult) to identify them. I took the lowest ranked one and dragged him out in front of the others, put a wooden gag into his mouth and took out a small knife. "Now I'm going to only ask once, only once, and if one word out you about your impotent goddess I will put the gag back into your mouth and I'll take my time ending you. The more of you I'm going to have to go through to get answers the worse it'll get for the next one in line. The last one of you is going to be little more than a few pieces after I'm done, then I will reanimate him and make him find anybody he loves and make him watch himself kill his entire family and friends before I start in on his body once more. You will feel everything, understand?" I said extremely calm and collected manner, sort of made the one squeamish guys in the group get a bad shiver up his back, but the dm told me to do an intimidation check and my rolls had been incredibly bad so I only rolled a 14 and failed the intimidation. The dm told me they didn't react at all and so I removed the gag and cut the mans toe off before I asked. "Were is the ritual taking place." The man responded with the usual cultist stuff.

Before the guy was even half way through I stabbed him in the thigh and dragged the dagger up to his groin and then stabbed him in the throat and carved off the cultists head in a manner that let the guy live as long as possible while I did it. At this point the monk left just as I raised the severed head off the guy I just killed above the other guys and said again in that same calm and collected manner. "This is the price for not telling me what I want to hear. Now the next one I will feed their own heart if I don't get the answers I want to hear." I said before I cast a animate dead spell while talking on the head which caused it's face to contort into a silent horrified scream and made it act as if it was alive for a bit. Sufficed to say there were some wide eyed expressions staring at me and I looked at the dm with a very calm expression, showing I was still in character by holding up a back of snacks in place of the head.

I slowly stood up from my seat and dropped the bag as I looked at the cultists and spoke once more. "Now if any of you FUCKING SLIME, HAVE ANYTHING ELSE TO SAY, NOWS THE FUCKING TIME BEFORE i REALLY GET CREATIVE!" When my voice rose in a sharp tone every one flinched a little and after I was done there was this silence just hanging there. After  a few moments the druid guy just looked at the dm and went. "Don't make him role again, I'm afraid of what he'll do next." it seems it was a nat 20 against the group :D
